It is Wednesday, June 10th, 2026. Our time is at 8pm. Seconded by Tom. I saw his hand. Okay. Is there anyone opposed to or abstaining from this motion? Okay. Hearing none, then the minutes are approved unanimously with a vote of 4-0. And good evening, Mary Lou, the Chair and Board of Finance members. I'd like to give, as I do in every monthly meeting, a progress status update on, you know, the pie charts on where the audit stands. And I'd also like to cover the pension audits as well. So, for the fiscal 25 audit planning, we have 100% accepted and fulfillment from the auditors, RSM auditors. And then for the city's year-end fieldwork, we have outstanding only now 13.5%. We have accepted and fulfilled to the auditors 84.8%. And we have returned 1.7% from the auditors. And we had our audit committee, sorry, RSM meeting today, this afternoon. And the auditors are making progress through working through a lot of the testing material. So, we're hoping to get that percentage down even further on the outstanding items. Before I move on. You think that by July we'll have this done? We did ask the auditors and they said that we are still on target for the end of July. Absolutely. Thank you. With regard to the pension audits, which is, for the board's knowledge, this is with a different auditing group, which is CBIS. I have some progress update as well. We have outstanding approximately 21% on the SURF audit. And we have accepted and fulfilled with the auditors there about 79%. And no returned items. And then for the custodian and mechanic pension audit, we have about 76% accepted and fulfilled, 24% outstanding. With the fire pension, we have approximately 21% outstanding to fulfill with 79% as well accepted and fulfilled. Any questions for the board with regard to these items? The police pension audit? Did you mention that? Yeah, the police is covered by the city's pension audit. It's under that umbrella, Richard, and so is OPEB. So, these other three audits are covered by CBIS. They're the auditors on that. Teresa, do you expect those will be done in July as well? My expectation for these are going to be 7-1. Oh, okay. And WPCA is on track? WPCA is completed. We actually have published. Fiscal 25 audit is completed. Lauren is published. We have a hard copy of them. That has to be done in April. Yes, that's correct. I mean, the ACFR is not done until the pension audits are done, correct? That's correct, Richard. So, the plan was to make sure that the pension audits were completed, especially with the footnote disclosures, so that we can incorporate those as well into the ACFR. So, do you find it the equal amount of effort or accuracy when you're auditing the different pension funds? Because I know that the CERF custodians and OPEB have, I think, entirely publicly traded assets, which are easier to mark, and fire and police don't, which can make it a little more difficult to audit. Have you found that, or is that not the case? I haven't found that as the case. I actually found it in the reverse case, because the fire pensions have the alternative investments, which I think are a little bit harder, and the police, I think, have some alternative. That's what I meant. Oh, okay. Yeah, yes, they have the alternative. Yeah, they're a little bit more difficult, yes, to get the investment disclosures. All right, thank you. All right, anybody else? All right. Hearing none, then it passes 5-0. Thank you. Okay. Thank you, Anita. Are you here for the next one as well? I am, if you'll have me. Okay. And this is a request for an additional appropriation for the Stanford Police Department for federal funds in the amount of $324,646. The floor is yours, Anita. Go ahead. Thank you, and I will be brief. So, as you know, the police department has their behavioral health unit. They have a partnership with Recovery Network of Programs. RNP received a SAMHSA grant, and so this kind of dovetails with the justice and mental health grant, which ends. We've had an extension on that, but they were able to continue this partnership with RNP through a SAMHSA grant that they received, and we're a subrecipient of that. Good night. All right, thank you, everyone. Thank you. Good night. Good night. Bye-bye.
